ten: Nguoi vao lenh dau, bot lo phan sau
mo_ta: Lenh dau do nguoi dat (hoac che do manual / magic 0); bot chi lo them lenh, TP, trailing.
vet: Khong quan sat duoc tu lich su lenh: lenh dau khong theo quy luat nao; chi thay phan bot lam (luoi, TP).

engine.ghi_chu: Can mot nguoi hoac mot luat vao; thay bang khoi VAO co dieu kien de mo phong.

ap_cheo: Thay 'nguoi' bang mot luat vao do duoc (vd 3 khung SSL cua HandDCA, hoac luat tim bang tim_quy_luat) roi thu phan quan ly cua bot nay.
rui_ro: Bot khong co phan vao: ket qua phu thuoc hoan toan nguoi dung, khong the tu chay.
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
